gloss_en: hello, good morning, how are you today
notes: [greeting] French donor (fr-FR); Levantine loan table (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964). Pipeline hardwires en-GB donor so misreads it: bonjour→boːʒu (nasal ɔ̃→oː, ʒ retained). Pipeline en-GB→bundʒawar. French bonjour is daily Beiruti speech (cowell1964). frame register cowell1964; Beiruti imala almbark2015/fadda2016.

gloss_en: thank you very much for the help
notes: [daily] French donor (fr-FR); Levantine loan table (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964). Pipeline hardwires en-GB donor so misreads it: merci→maɣsi (French ʁ→ɣ, per ar-MA precedent). Pipeline en-GB→marsi. ʕa preposition kept unfronted (register). frame register cowell1964; Beiruti imala almbark2015/fadda2016.

gloss_en: so, how are you doing now?
notes: [greeting] French donor (fr-FR); Levantine loan table (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964). Pipeline hardwires en-GB donor so misreads it: ça va→safa (v→f Levantine, Al-Saidat 2011). Pipeline mangles the Latin to 'a fa'. ça va is stock Beiruti greeting (cowell1964). hallaʔ ق→ʔ (almbark2015).

sentence: رُحْت عَ الْ pharmacie جِبْت دَوَا
raw: رحت ع ال pharmacie جبت دوا
ipa: ˈruħt ˈʕa l faɣmasi ˈʒibt ˈdawaː
gloss_en: I went to the pharmacy and got medicine
notes: [daily] French donor (fr-FR); Levantine loan table (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964). Pipeline hardwires en-GB donor so misreads it: pharmacie→faɣmasi (ʁ→ɣ). Pipeline en-GB→faːrmasiː. ʕa kept unfronted (register); ج=/ʒ/ ʒibt (cowell1964). frame register cowell1964; Beiruti imala almbark2015/fadda2016.

gloss_en: the food in the kitchen is good
notes: [daily] French donor (fr-FR); Levantine loan table (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964). Pipeline hardwires en-GB donor so misreads it: cuisine→kwizin (front /y/→w-glide). Pipeline en-GB→kuːzin. emphatic ط ṭayyib (watson2002). frame register cowell1964; Beiruti imala almbark2015/fadda2016.

gloss_en: I lost my phone
notes: [tech] French donor (fr-FR); Levantine loan table (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964). Pipeline hardwires en-GB donor so misreads it: telephone→telefoːn (final ɔ→oː; French téléphone is the everyday Beiruti word). Pipeline en-GB→tilifun. emphatic ض backing dˤɑːʕe (watson2002). frame register cowell1964; Beiruti imala almbark2015/fadda2016.

gloss_en: I want to send an email to the manager now
notes: [tech] email→imeːl (mid-long /eː/ native to Levantine, Cowell 1964). baddi 'I want' (cowell1964); ق→ʔ hallaʔ. table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

gloss_en: I have an important meeting with the manager
notes: [tech] meeting→miːtink (/ŋ/→[nk] at pausal). table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

gloss_en: did you see the manager in the office
notes: [work] manager→manadʒar (ǧīm reflex [dʒ] in loan; urban jīm is [ʒ] natively). table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

gloss_en: I bought a new laptop but it is expensive
notes: [tech] laptop→labtub (/p/→[b] onset and coda). ج=/ʒ/ ʒdiːd; bass 'but' (cowell1964). table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

sentence: بَدِّي أَشْتَرِي online مِش مِن الْمَحَلّ
raw: بدي أشتري online مش من المحل
ipa: ˈbaddiː ˈʔaʃtariː unlin ˈmiʃ min almaˈħall
gloss_en: I want to buy online, not from the shop
notes: [commerce] online→unlin. miš nominal negation (cowell1964). table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

gloss_en: I think this book is expensive
notes: [daily] think→θink (interdental /θ/ RETAINED in Levantine, unlike Cairene [t]). hādā demonstrative (cowell1964). table: Levantine (Al-Saidat 2011; Cowell 1964)

gloss_en: I have a flat tyre in the car
notes: [automotive] Arabic-script loan banšar 'flat tyre/puncture' (< Eng. puncture; Levantine everyday form). Pipeline reads the vocalised word faithfully → banʃar, the attested realisation. frame register cowell1964; Beiruti imala almbark2015/fadda2016.

gloss_en: the computer is slow today
notes: [tech] Arabic-script loan kambyūtar 'computer' (< Eng. computer). Pipeline reads it faithfully → kambjuːtar, the attested realisation. aw→oː il-yōm (almbark2015).

gloss_en: I forgot the mobile at home
notes: [tech] Arabic-script loan mōbāyl 'mobile phone'. Attested Beiruti realisation /moˈbajl/. Pipeline over-reads و as [uː] and inserts a leading length artifact → almuˈːbaːjl (wrong); correct loan IPA pinned here.

gloss_en: I took a service-taxi to town
notes: [transport] Arabic-script loan servees 'shared service-taxi', iconic Beirut word (< Fr. service). Attested realisation /sarˈviːs/ (v retained in this French-route loan). Pipeline emits siˈːrfiːs (leading length artifact, f for v). ʕa kept unfronted (register).

gloss_en: this car is automatic
notes: [automotive] Arabic-script loan otomatik 'automatic' (< Fr. automatique). Attested realisation /ʔotomaˈtik/. Pipeline over-lengthens and fronts aː→eː → ʔuːtuːmeˈːtiːk (wrong); correct loan IPA pinned here.

gloss_en: hi, how are you, everything ok
notes: [greeting] Beiruti Arabizi: 7=ح. Spells مَرْحَبَا كِيفَك كِلّ شِي تَمَام (kīfak; kill ši tamām 'all good', cowell1964). Pipeline has no Arabizi path (reads Latin as en-GB loan); IPA hand-derived from the Arabic it spells.

gloss_en: I am talking to you now
notes: [daily] Beiruti Arabizi: 3=ع, 7=ح, 2=ء(ق→ʔ). Spells عَم بَحْكِي مَعَك هَلَّق (ʕam progressive + baħki 'talk', hallaʔ 'now'; cowell1964). Pipeline has no Arabizi path; IPA hand-derived from the Arabic.

gloss_en: I want to go home tomorrow
notes: [daily] Beiruti Arabizi: 7=ح, 3=ع, bade=بَدِّي. Spells بَدِّي رُوح عَ الْبَيْت بُكْرَا. ʕa preposition and bukra kept UNFRONTED (real Beiruti CS register; pipeline over-fronts to ʕe/bukreː). Pipeline has no Arabizi path; IPA hand-derived.
